drafts.add-recipe-subtitle: From a link, a text or a photo
drafts.intake-description: A link, a text or a photo: the recipe is recognized and waits in the drafts until someone checks and saves it.
drafts.working-hint: Being recognized, this takes a few seconds.
drafts.discard-confirm: Discard this draft? Its original is deleted as well.

warning.units_converted: The source says {name}; the amounts were converted, please check.

error.ai_not_configured: No AI set up: Group Settings → AI Providers
error.quota_exceeded: The AI quota is used up, please try again later.
error.invalid_result: The recognition did not return a valid recipe.
error.unknown: Something went wrong, please try again.
error.no_source: Add a link, a text or a photo.
error.several_sources: Only one at a time: a link, a text or photos.
error.not_an_image: One of the files is not a photo.
error.not_ready: This draft is not ready yet.
error.not_failed: Only drafts that failed can be tried again.
error.still_working: Still being recognized, please wait a moment.
error.offline: No connection to Küchenhelfer. Check the network; it tries again in a moment.
error.ai_unavailable: No AI reachable, try again later.

drafts.shortcut-hint: Quicker on the phone: with the shortcut from the guide, recipes come straight from the share menu.

nav.intake-waiting: Intake, 1 draft waiting | Intake, {count} drafts waiting
nav.drafts-waiting: 1 draft waits for a review | {count} drafts wait for a review

recipe.time-hint: With this much more or less, baking and cooking times often change.

ai.order-hint: The AI asks the providers from top to bottom. If one fails, it takes the next.

free-keys.title: Free keys
free-keys.hint: Free tiers change often. The test button shows whether a model fits. You enter the keys yourself.

ai.unavailable-hint: The AI can't be reached right now. Links with recipe data still work; please try photos and texts again later.
ai.order-failed: The order could not be saved; the list has been reloaded.
ai.missing-hint: No AI set up yet: Küchenhelfer reads photos and texts once someone adds an AI provider. Links with recipe data already work.

amounts.egg-tip: Whisk one egg and use half.

timer.title: Timer
timer.clock-switch: Also offer timers in the Clock app
timer.clock-hint: Shows a button on every timer that starts the Clock app's timer. It rings on a locked phone, too. This device needs the shortcut set up once, see the guide.

cook.lock-hint: This device cannot keep the screen on by itself. Set its automatic lock to a longer time in the settings so the screen stays on while you cook.
